2025-06-15.riddle: I’m filled with ink, I help you write, I sign your name both day and night. I’m clicked or capped to keep me neat— What am I?
2025-06-15.hint: I live on desks and in pockets.

2025-06-16.riddle: I open wide but have no lips, I carry sharp or rounded tips. You’ll find me in kitchens or toolkits too— What am I?

2025-06-17.riddle: I climb but have no feet, I hang on walls, both plain and neat. Numbers mark my steady race— What am I?
2025-06-17.hint: I help you keep track of time.

2025-06-18.riddle: I’m full of holes but hold things tight, I catch your dreams throughout the night. Hung on walls with beads and thread— What am I?
2025-06-18.hint: I’m said to trap bad dreams.

2025-06-19.riddle: I work with ink, but I’m not a pen, You roll me on and off again. I stamp out letters crisp and clean— What am I?
2025-06-19.hint: I used to write before computers.

2025-06-20.riddle: I’m made of glass, I bend the light, I help you see both far and right. I sit on noses, light as air— What am I?
2025-06-20.hint: I’m worn to help you read.

2025-06-21.riddle: I move around on rails or tracks, I carry people forth and back. I’m long and loud with whistles clear— What am I?
2025-06-21.hint: I pass through stations every day.

2025-06-22.riddle: I’m sharp and tiny, used in thread, I have an eye but no real head. I help to make your clothes complete— What am I?

2025-06-23.riddle: I’m round and bright, I shine at night, Reflecting beams from far-off light. You’ll find me changing shape with time— What am I?
2025-06-23.hint: I glow softly in the dark sky.
